lines.description: Number of lines to buffer per channel/window

scrollback_lines.description: Lines to retain in memory for scrollback

auto_rejoin.description: Automatically rejoin a channel if kicked

default_channels.description: List of channels to join on connect

join_on_connect.description: Automatically join configured channels after connecting

rejoin_delay.description: Seconds to wait before rejoining after kick/part

channel_overrides.description: Per-channel overrides for join behavior or modes

auto_join.description: Override global join-on-connect setting for this channel

user_modes.description: User modes to request in this channel (e.g. '+o')

max_reconnect_attempts.description: Maximum attempts to reconnect before giving up

reconnect_delay.description: Seconds to wait before reconnecting on disconnect

server.description: Optional custom DNS server (e.g. '8.8.8.8'); empty uses system default

usermode.description: User modes to request on connect (e.g. 'i' for invisible)

directory.description: Directory where log files are stored

host.description: IRC server hostname or IP address

password.description: Server password (if required); leave empty if not needed

port.description: IRC server port (typically 6667 for plain or 6697 for SSL)

use_ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for the connection
